title: D-World: An Explicit World-Language-Action Model with Recursive Self-Improvement under Dual Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.17114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) now reason about space well enough to program robots, yet the world models behind robot policies are implicit, held in network weights or predicted video, and cannot be inspected or corrected directly. We present D-World, an explicit world-language-action model built on the Sense, Plan and Act decomposition. A perception agent writes the scene as an executable digital twin using generated vision and geometry code. A planning agent searches for actions in simulation and, after each executed action chunk, revises the twin's object states and named physical parameters against what the robot measured. A parameter revision is accepted only if replaying the latest chunk does not increase any measured residual beyond its tolerance, and every chunk is checked in the updated twin before it runs. Structural mismatches return to perception for reconstruction. We call this measurement-grounded cycle of correct

translated_title: D-World：双控制下具备递归自我改进能力的显式世界-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 前沿大语言模型（LLM）如今对空间的推理能力已足以编写机器人程序，然而机器人策略背后的世界模型却是隐式的，存在于网络权重或预测视频之中，无法被直接检查或修正。我们提出了 D-World，一个基于“感知-规划-行动”分解构建的显式世界-语言-动作模型。感知智能体利用生成的视觉与几何代码将场景编写为可执行的数字孪生体。规划智能体在仿真中搜索动作，并在每执行一个动作块后，根据机器人的实际测量结果修订孪生体中的物体状态及具名物理参数。只有当重放最新动作块不会使任何测量残差超出其容许范围时，参数修订才会被接受，且每个动作块在运行前都会在更新后的孪生体中进行检查。结构不匹配的情况则会返回感知模块进行重建。我们将这一基于测量的修正循环称为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: D-World 提出了一种显式的世界-语言-动作模型，通过感知智能体构建可执行数字孪生、规划智能体在仿真中搜索动作并依据真实测量递归修订参数，使机器人策略背后的世界模型首次变得可检查、可修正并具备自我改进能力。
en_tdlr: D-World introduces an explicit world-language-action model in which a perception agent builds an executable digital twin and a planning agent recursively revises its parameters against real measurements, making the world model behind robot policies directly inspectable, correctable, and self-improving.
